summary: Completed the bounded M17 managed-workload PREPARE, consent, exactly-once detached dispatch, reconciliation, and Activity lifecycle without verification or live-device execution.
completed: Typed non-mutating PREPARE with bounded protocol parsing, trusted action validation, and a human-confirmable consent fingerprint.
Fresh consent revalidation rejects configuration, action digest, target revision, and verification-identity drift as PlanChanged before dispatch.
Persisted-before-dispatch backend-generated transient-unit identity, fixed non-root systemd-run command, and persisted attempt boundary.
Exactly-once dispatch with Accepted or recoverable DispatchUncertain outcomes, followed only by same-unit bounded reconciliation.
Conservative lifecycle translation to Deploying, DeploymentFailed, StillRunning, or AwaitingVerification, with deduplicated sanitized Activity and no workload alert suppression.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: PREPARE is non-mutating and derives action execution only from fixed-root trusted action resolution.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Fixed scripted tests cover no APPLY/systemd-run during PREPARE and strict action-ID/trust validation.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Consent drift returns PlanChanged with zero dispatch and no caller-controlled target, command, unit, argv, flags, environment, or path surface.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Deterministic consent and dispatch-construction tests cover config, digest, target, and verification drift plus exact fixed command construction.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A dispatch is persisted and attempted at most once, while uncertainty, restart, expiry, and reconciliation only observe the persisted unit and never kill or redispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: One-shot dispatch and reconciliation tests cover persisted attempt boundaries, uncertain outcomes, recovery identity/deadline, expiry, and no redispatch.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Systemd success stops at AwaitingVerification; failure and initiation Activity are deduplicated and sanitized; device-wide alert suppression is absent.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Activity and reconciliation tests assert AwaitingVerification only, one static Activity event per outcome, no sensitive data, and no administration disruption record.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The M16 detached-operation extraction preserves maintenance persistence and typed fixed-command semantics.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: M16 maintenance, coordinator, and shared-substrate regression suites passed; shared code has no command construction or persistence model.

notes: No PI 5 or other real device was contacted, changed, or dispatched.
Exact revision verification, Docker/Compose verification, Service Health verification, and final completed/success Activity are intentionally deferred to WU103 and are not WU102 residual work.

Risk at this boundary: medium (44/100), because a future typed dispatch authority exists but is constrained by trust, consent, one-shot persistence, bounded observation, and no generic command surface.
